name: show-it-works
description: Plugins for proving a coding task really works: record the run, then publish it as a share link. Hosted from the Show It Works UI repository.

plugins.name: show-it-works-ui
plugins.description: Every finished coding task ends with a screen recording of the real run and a share link. AI agents publish proof-of-work videos over MCP; you verify results at your own pace — later, from your phone, anywhere — while your other agent sessions keep moving.

plugins.name: ui-evidence-recorder
plugins.description: Records the video the other plugin publishes: a Playwright studio page that never navigates, a title card over the app's boot, a drawn cursor, a highlight ring before every click, a narration bar and severity-coloured notes. Optional — Show It Works accepts any watchable MP4 or WebM.
